## Design rulings (ADR-0297)

- **D1** — `input_required` is a non-terminal lifecycle marker
  (`action.effect.input_required`), never a re-dispatch: same
  `effect_id`, `attempt_no + 1`, opaque `requestState` echo.
- **D2** — the generic edge vocabulary lives in `hh-mcp`
  (`ProtocolBinding`, pin sets, negotiate sums); `hh-acp` consumes,
  never duplicates (CC1).
- **D3** — the event-class → update-kind lowering table + task-state /
  tool-kind projections live in `hh-compiler` (single source, CC7);
  `hh-acp` renders, never re-derives.
- **D4** — `OriginPolicy` is an exact-match allowlist, fail-closed before
  dispatch; the request body is always drained before any refusal (an
  early close with unread body resets the connection and swallows the
  refusal — observed as `Connection reset by peer` in the fixture).
- **D5** — OAuth 2.1 authorization-code + PKCE S256 + RFC 8707 `resource`
  + RFC 9207 `iss` binding through H3; the bearer stays in transport/H3
  custody — only a fingerprint is ledgerable.
- **D6** — A2A `AgentCard.version = bundle_id`; card signature verifies
  under the fixture `TrustRootPolicy` and fails closed under a wrong
  root; `TaskState` projection is exhaustive (never coerced).
- **D7** — `session/new.mcpServers[]` is admitted only as
  `pending_review` (the H5-review gate) — never silently activated.
- **D8** — v1 compatibility is a profile projection of the one artefact
  (filtered update kinds, `observability_level {events, end_state}`, no
  `ledger`, unknown controls, component metrics `n/a`), not a second
  artefact.

## Landed

- **`hh-acp` (new crate)** — `protocol` (pin set, `ACP_VERSION="0.1.0"`,
  `negotiate_era`, `acp_binding`, era/v1-compat profile), `artifact`
  (`hh-acp-target/1` session artefact: schema/content hash, `render_session`,
  `edge_loss_report`), `transport` (`SessionTransport` + thread-safe
  in-memory pair for fixtures), `driver` (scripted session agent:
  durable-before-visible ordering — `state_update{idle}` never precedes
  `lifecycle.turn.finished`), `permission` (request/decide through the Π
  seam — `request_permission` only when `security.permission.requested
  {decider: human}` exists; cancel → `action.effect.refused`; nothing
  dispatches before `security.permission.decided`; `allow_always` lands
  as a ledgered policy amendment or downgrades `allow_once`), `serve`
  (the server loop + `_hh/*` methods: `_hh/ledger/read`, `_hh/account`,
  `_hh/participant/describe`; `session/*` verbs; `session/resume` durable
  tail replay; `subscriptions/listen`; `mcpServers[] → pending_review`;
  `configOptions[]`), `client` (the binding-(c) `attach_session` client —
  v2 + three v1 hosts → descriptors with `observability_level`, no
  `ledger`, unknown controls, component metrics `n/a`), `a2a` (exhaustive
  `TaskState` projection — `INPUT_REQUIRED` resumes the child run —
  `AgentCard{version: bundle_id}` + signature verify/fail-closed +
  `delegate_task` records).
- **`hh-mcp`** — `executor` (new: `McpExecutor` — observed →
  `TerminalStatus::Ok`; `input_required` → `Paused{request_state}`
  verbatim; `isError` → tool-plane failure; JSON-RPC error →
  transport-plane; unclassifiable → transport), `http` (new: Streamable
  HTTP serve loop + `HttpTransport` client + `OriginPolicy` exact-match
  allowlist + bearer gate answering `401` + `WWW-Authenticate`
  `resource_metadata` challenge + `Mcp-Session-Id` on `initialize` +
  catalogue-change → `list_changed` queue for `subscriptions/listen`),
  `oauth` (new: OAuth 2.1 code flow, PKCE S256, RFC 8707 audience, RFC
  9207 issuer binding, `TokenGrant`; bearer custody at the transport —
  fingerprint only ledgerable), `client` (`call_tool_keyed` — the
  `target` idempotency key at `tools/call.params.target`),
  `protocol` (`binding.request_target`), `server` (`target` name-keyed
  dedup; `subscriptions/listen` drain).
- **`hh-env`** — `ExecutionRequest.request_state` (opaque, never parsed),
  `TerminalStatus::Paused`, `DispatchOutcome::Paused`, the pause arm
  (`input_required` marker + ask decision + derived-scope `message_human`
  elicitation; the effect stays non-terminal), `resume_paused` (typed
  refusal without the pause trail; same `effect_id`; `attempt_no + 1`;
  byte-exact `requestState` echo; the recorded commit evidence of attempt
  1 is reused, never re-emitted).
- **`hh-ledger`** — `action.effect.input_required` class + non-terminal
  paused lifecycle handling (retry commits the next attempt; permission
  gate validation preserved).
- **`hh-compiler`** — `acp` (new: `lower_event`/`AcpDialect`, the
  tool-kind/task-state projections, `lower_target` + `lift` for
  `hh-acp-target/1`, `PartialHIR` recovery, `LoweredTarget.loss_report
  {granularity: configuration}`), `target.rs` dispatch.
- **`Cargo.toml`** — `crates/hh-acp` workspace member.

## Log

- 2026-09-26: implemented per plan; `hh-acp` created; paused-arm plumbed
  end-to-end (`hh-mcp` executor → `hh-env` dispatcher → `hh-ledger`
  marker); compiler `target: acp` landed.
- 2026-09-26 (incident): first in-memory session transport used
  `Rc<RefCell>` — not `Send`; replaced with `Arc<Mutex<VecDeque>>` +
  split local/peer close flags.
- 2026-09-26 (incident): `resume_paused` re-emitted
  `action.effect.committed` for an already-committed attempt →
  `BadEffectTransition`; fixed by reusing the recorded commit evidence.
  The retry's `observed` then violated `attempt_no` equality against the
  attempt-1 commit — resolved by the explicit `action.effect.input_required`
  marker + non-terminal paused phase (the retry commits attempt 2
  correctly; D1).
- 2026-09-26 (incident): HTTP 401/403 paths reset the client connection —
  the serve loop refused before reading the request body (RST on close
  with unread inbound data); reordered to drain `Content-Length` before
  the guards (D4). The `edit`-tool stale-view anomaly (LEDGER finding
  2026-09-18) recurred on `hh-mcp/src/http.rs` — edits reported success,
  content absent afterward; all subsequent writes went through
  shell/python with `grep` verification.
- 2026-09-26 (incident): a `cargo fmt --all` pass reformatted five
  untouched crates (hh-control, hh-lab, hh-registry, hh-telemetry,
  hh-verification — the pre-existing repo-wide drift S4.5a recorded);
  all hunks verified fmt-only (no S4.5b references) and reverted.
- 2026-09-26: clippy — fixed all warnings on touched crates
  (`vec_init_then_push` in `hh-compiler::acp`, `needless_borrow` ×3,
  `too_many_arguments` allow-with-comment per codebase precedent,
  `unnecessary_get_then_check`, complex-type alias, `to_string` on

- 2026-09-26: verification — full `cargo test --workspace` 187 result
